description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PayGradeService in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains various test methods verifying the behavior of PayGradeService functions, including CRUD operations on pay grades, currencies, and related data. The class uses mocking to isolate tests and loads fixture data for consistent testing environments.

classes.name: PayGradeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the functionalities of PayGradeService, including CRUD operations, data retrieval, and filtering related to pay grades and currencies within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating a PayGradeService instance and populating test data from fixture files.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeDao
methods.description: Tests if the PayGradeDao instance returned by PayGradeService is correctly instantiated.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Verifies that PayGradeService retrieves the list of pay grades correctly.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a specific pay grade by its ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Ensures correct fetching of currency list associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a specific currency associated with a pay grade using currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of PayPeriod entities to array with id and label.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of PayGrade entities to array with id and label.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of CurrencyType entities to array with id and label.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Validates retrieval of count of pay grade currencies matching filter.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of list of pay grade currencies based on filter.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Verifies saving a pay grade returns a PayGrade object.

methods.name: testSavePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Verifies saving a pay grade currency returns a PayGradeCurrency object.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Tests deletion of pay grades by IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Checks retrieval of allowed pay currencies based on filter.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Verifies count of allowed pay currencies according to filter.
